findings.current: 其他成员会被告知，智能体所有者可以审计此对话。
findings.proposed: 其他成员被告知，智能体所有者可以审计此对话。
findings.reason: 会 leans future ('will be told') where the source states a standing present fact and the other six locales render it in the present. 会被告知 is idiomatic habitual Chinese and the fact holds either way, so this is a preference; dropping 会 would track the English tense exactly.

Satisfies every hard requirement (label, 也 for 'also', no colon, no placeholder, reader excluded) and is compact, but 者 leaves the referent implicit, so the label can be read as 'viewable items' rather than the people whose names are listed below it; it also uses 查看 where the disclosure directly above says 阅读. Recorded, not churned.

findings.current: 因此之后的消息不包含在内。
findings.proposed: 因此之后的消息不在此审计内。
findings.reason: The shared second half (identical in ui.ownerAudit.removed, as the sidecar requires) leaves the container implicit where English says 'not in it' (the audit). 不包含在内 carries no antecedent binding the way a pronoun does; this is not the ru 'в нём' defect class because nothing asserts the conversation ended, so it is a clarity preference.
